Title: C# Fundamentals
Description: Learn the basics of the C# programming language, including syntax, data types, and control structures. This course will introduce you to the core concepts of programming with C#, such as variables, operators, loops, and conditional statements. You'll also explore how to work with methods, arrays, and basic object-oriented programming principles like classes and objects. Perfect for beginners who want to understand the foundational aspects of C# and start writing efficient, clean code from the start.

Title: C# Advance
Description: Learn the advanced concepts of C# programming language, including object-oriented programming (OOP), LINQ (Language Integrated Query), asynchronous programming, advanced data structures, and best practices for building efficient, scalable applications. This course dives deep into topics like delegates, events, generics, reflection, and more. Perfect for developers who are already familiar with the basics of C# and want to take their skills to the next level.
